label: automated regression evaluation — not independent acceptance
authorship: Written by Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-10-15 from the prompts' explicit requirements. The frozen set and its mechanical checks are unchanged; this overlay adds regression checks beside them. It was written after earlier answers to this set existed, so it is a regression probe, not an acceptance criterion.

instructionChecks.note: Checks of explicit form requirements in a prompt that the frozen mechanical checks do not already test. Check types are the frozen set's checkTypes, with their semantics, plus codeOnly (defined below).
instructionChecks.codeOnly: The answer is code only. When it has fenced code blocks, nothing but whitespace lies outside them; otherwise the whole answer parses as the named language (Python ast.parse, or node --check for JavaScript). Nothing is executed.

items.requirement: Explain in two or three sentences.
A JavaScript function doubleEvens(numbers) using filter and map.
A JavaScript function doubleEvens(numbers) using filter and map.
A Python function is_palindrome(s). Just the code.
Reply with only the corrected sentence.

codeExecution.note: Each case runs the answer's own code verbatim in a fresh directory outside the repository, then a probe appended by the harness calls the named function on the inputs the prompt names. Expected values follow from the prompt. Code is extracted as in artifacts/useful-answer-set-20261014/scripts/run-answer-code.py: fenced blocks tagged with the language (or untagged), otherwise the whole answer.

cases.functionNote: The prompt names no function; the probe calls the first function the code declares.
